## Eligibility

| Field | Recorded value |
| --- | --- |
| Company Required at Application | No rigid incorporation requirement published; startup/team with evidence of progress required |
| Geography / Affiliation Restriction | Global applicants welcome; international startups need a clear, realistic and obtainable plan to expand to Saudi Arabia within one year of program start |
| Can Apply Pre-Idea | No / evidence of startup progress required |
| Can Apply Solo | No — at least two founders required |

| Strong-to-Have | Strong complementary team, scalable business model, customer-focused founders, evidence of market validation, clear Saudi expansion strategy for international startups. |
| Eligibility Disclosure Status | Verified / Public |
| Eligibility Confidence | High |
